_comment: Editable rules mapping IRS Online Account document titles to filename summaries. irs_site.py titles a transcript 'IRS <Type> Transcript <tax period>'; each matches a tax rule below. Notices are not listed yet (the notices page stops the run when it shows one); when they are, a notice matches none of these and is filed as an Other Document named by its IRS code (irs_docs.notice_summary).
